name: uefitools
description: UEFI firmware analysis and manipulation tools for reverse engineering and security research

uefi-extract.description: Extract and analyze UEFI firmware images, modules, and components
uefi-extract.usage:
UEFIExtract firmware.fd
UEFIExtract -dump firmware.fd output/
UEFIExtract -info firmware.fd
UEFIExtract -text firmware.fd

uefi-find.description: Search for patterns, strings, and signatures within UEFI firmware images
uefi-find.usage:
UEFIFind firmware.fd text 'string_to_find'
UEFIFind firmware.fd hex '48656C6C6F'
UEFIFind firmware.fd guid AAAAAAAA-BBBB-CCCC-DDDD-EEEEEEEEEEEE
UEFIFind firmware.fd all
